com.sun.security.ntlm

类 Server

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.security.ntlm.Server

  • public abstract class Server
extends Object
    The NTLM server, not multi-thread enabled.

    Example: 

     Server server = new Server(null, "REALM") {
     public char[] getPassword(String ntdomain, String username) {
         switch (username) {
             case "dummy": return "t0pSeCr3t".toCharArray();
             case "guest": return "".toCharArray();
             default: return null;
         }
     }
 };
 // Receive client request as type1
 byte[] type2 = server.type2(type1, nonce);
 // Send type2 to client and receive type3
 verify(type3, nonce);

    • 构造器详细资料

      • Server

        public Server(String version,
              String domain)
       throws NTLMException
        Creates a Server instance.
        参数:
        version - the NTLM version to use, which can be:
        • NTLM: Original NTLM v1
        • NTLM2: NTLM v1 with Client Challenge
        • NTLMv2: NTLM v2
        If null, all versions will be supported. Please note that unless NTLM2 is selected, authentication succeeds if one of LM (or LMv2) or NTLM (or NTLMv2) is verified.
        domain - the domain, must not be null
        抛出:
        NTLMException - if domain is null.

    • 方法详细资料

      • type2

        public byte[] type2(byte[] type1,
                    byte[] nonce)
             throws NTLMException
        Generates the Type 2 message
        参数:
        type1 - the Type1 message received, must not be null
        nonce - the random 8-byte array to be used in message generation, must not be null
        返回:
        the message generated
        抛出:
        NTLMException - if the incoming message is invalid, or nonce is null.

      • verify

        public String[] verify(byte[] type3,
                       byte[] nonce)
                throws NTLMException
        Verifies the Type3 message received from client and returns various negotiated information.
        参数:
        type3 - the incoming Type3 message from client, must not be null
        nonce - the same nonce provided in type2(byte[], byte[]), must not be null
        返回:
        client username, client hostname, and the request target
        抛出:
        NTLMException - if the incoming message is invalid, or nonce is null.

      • getPassword

        public abstract char[] getPassword(String domain,
                                   String username)
        Retrieves the password for a given user. This method should be overridden in a concrete class.
        参数:
        domain - can be null
        username - must not be null
        返回:
        the password for the user, or null if unknown

      • debug

        public void debug(String format,
                  Object... args)
        Prints out a formatted string, called in various places inside then NTLM implementation for debugging/logging purposes. When the system property "ntlm.debug" is set, System.out.printf(format, args) is called. This method is designed to be overridden by child classes to match their own debugging/logging mechanisms.
        参数:
        format - a format string
        args - the arguments referenced by format
        另请参阅:
        PrintStream.printf(java.lang.String, java.lang.Object[])

      • debug

        public void debug(byte[] bytes)
        Prints out the content of a byte array, called in various places inside the NTLM implementation for debugging/logging purposes. When the system property "ntlm.debug" is set, the hexdump of the array is printed into System.out. This method is designed to be overridden by child classes to match their own debugging/logging mechanisms.
        参数:
        bytes - the byte array to print out
